name: test_designer_v4 array-assertion discipline — the contradictory pair is unsatisfiable, the indexed path is satisfiable, and the prompt now teaches it (PHASE-54 R-47)
description: Locks, deterministically and mock-only, the semantics behind the R-47 prompt fix. (1) Harness truth: against an array response, response_body_is_array PASSES, a ROOT-level response_body_field_equals FAILS, and an INDEXED-path response_body_field_equals PASSES — so pairing is_array with a root-field assertion on the same response is unsatisfiable by construction, which is what made two consecutive generated plans unbuildable. (2) Fix presence: test_designer_v4 exists in the prompt registry with array guidance (list endpoints return arrays; never pair is_array with a root-field assertion; assert element content with an indexed path), v3 is retained and marked DEPRECATED, and the role binds v4. Does NOT test live model output.
